formula: R*_W=K_W-Q_W[(G_W-W*c1f*Dm)/L], with exact-real Y=Q_in(B+aK), ideal alb/EOS and source WRF mass flux
scope: unit-map, dry CQW zero, mode3 ImplicitOnly single tile FP64, reference update and reuse off, parity true, W-damping and HEVI off
bottom coupled force is zero but W product-rule term retained; physical U periodic seam and V wall normal zero; Q_W horizontal copy aliases only
B, K, coefficients and measured weight extrema are treated as exact captured binary values; B/K provenance and formation before capture excluded
all W entries and aliases are compared to native stored R; weighted mathematical RMS uses observed inverse-weight maximum times Linf and RNDU sqrt(Nw/N); native backend norm rounding excluded
interval_method: MPFR 256 RNDD/RNDU throughout. Positive-base sign-definite power uses mathematically monotone selected endpoints, four-corner fallback when exponent crosses zero; built-in tests compare exact MPFR endpoints against four-corner reference. Ideal alb is cached only by exact positive theta_base/pbase pair with fixed constants.
inputs: Normalized manifest expected: 16 flat FP64 files B,K0,K1,R0,R1,theta_base,pbase,mub,c1h,c2h,c1f,c2f,mass_rdnw,eos_rdnw,pressure_rdn,top_rdnw, top_rdnw is one actual scalar; plus constants a/rdx/rdy/g/rd/cv/cp/p0/t0 and observed W scale min/max. Metadata records original dtype and each file SHA; wrapper checks supported profile and bitwise equality EOS/mass rdnw and derives uniform weight-upper scratch file.
runtime_estimate: Uniform 10x10x8 synthetic, noninteger exponent: before optimization 3.31s, after 0.29s; naive linear extrapolation ~58s is not an upper bound and actual coefficient diversity/cache/RSS unmeasured. Raw arrays ~48MB, plus O(unique theta,pbase) MPFR cache and process overhead.
limitations: No actual data or full-grid evaluation before registered preflight.
No proof of whole RHS error, backend norm rounding, e_i descent or forecast convergence.
Flags/context in normalized manifest must be established by capture, not inferred from configuration intent.
